citations.quote: I don't know if that is mould or damp at all; it could also just be dust from the radiator.
The heating does not work properly: the boiler cuts out during the night, every night since the beginning of September, and our bedrooms are cold when we wake up.
The technician himself told me he could not find the cause and that the system needs to be examined by a specialist, possibly the manufacturer's service, to find out why it cuts out.
